CREATE TRIGGER "__cap_kv_U" AFTER UPDATE ON "kv" WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM __cap_on) BEGIN INSERT INTO __cap(tbl, oldk, newk) VALUES ('kv', json_array(CASE typeof(old."k") WHEN 'blob' THEN json_object('$b', lower(hex(old."k"))) WHEN 'real' THEN json(quote(old."k")) ELSE old."k" END), json_array(CASE typeof(new."k") WHEN 'blob' THEN json_object('$b', lower(hex(new."k"))) WHEN 'real' THEN json(quote(new."k")) ELSE new."k" END)); INSERT INTO "__capv_kv"(__seq, "k", "v", "r", "extra") VALUES ((SELECT max(seq) FROM __cap), old."k", old."v", old."r", old."extra"); END;

CREATE TRIGGER "__cap_kv_D" AFTER DELETE ON "kv" WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM __cap_on) BEGIN INSERT INTO __cap(tbl, oldk, newk) VALUES ('kv', json_array(CASE typeof(old."k") WHEN 'blob' THEN json_object('$b', lower(hex(old."k"))) WHEN 'real' THEN json(quote(old."k")) ELSE old."k" END), NULL); INSERT INTO "__capv_kv"(__seq, "k", "v", "r", "extra") VALUES ((SELECT max(seq) FROM __cap), old."k", old."v", old."r", old."extra"); END;
